entities.name: Sangarédi Bauxite Deposit
entities.short: One of the world's highest-grade bauxite deposits (56-58% Al₂O₃); gallium-bearing ore exported to Chinese alumina/gallium refineries.

entities.name: METLEN Red Mud / Gallium Project (Agios Nikolaos)
entities.short: €295.5M project to recover ~50 t/yr gallium from bauxite residue — Europe's first industrial gallium, from 2027 (integrated on-site recovery).

entities.name: Central Tennessee MVT Zinc District
entities.short: Carbonate-hosted sphalerite district; Ga (and Ge) documented in sphalerite; minor gallium byproduct source.

entities.name: Fankou Pb-Zn Mine/Deposit
entities.short: World-class Zn-Pb mine; Ga enriched in late-stage sphalerite (Zhongjin Lingnan); commercial Ga recovery unconfirmed.

entities.name: GaAs/GaN/LED Manufacturing New-Scrap Pool
entities.short: Dominant recycled feed: ~93% of gallium is lost as new scrap during wafer cutting/etching/polishing; the largest secondary Ga stream.

entities.name: Freiberger Compound Materials (Freiberg)
entities.short: GaAs wafer fab; generates Ga-bearing scrap & wastewater; on-site HZDR siderophore Ga-recovery pilot (2024).

entities.name: SMB-Winning Boké Bauxite Mine
entities.short: Largest Guinean bauxite exporter (SMB-Winning consortium incl. China Hongqiao); primary feed to Chinese alumina/gallium refineries.

entities.name: Nyrstar Middle Tennessee Mines
entities.short: MVT zinc mines + Gordonsville mill; Ga/Ge-bearing concentrate → Clarksville. Paused since Nov 2023.

entities.name: Binzhou Huihong Alumina Refinery
entities.short: Weiqiao/Hongqiao Bayer refinery (~4→8 Mt/yr); Bayer liquor feeds co-located Jiayuan gallium plant (120 t/yr Ga target).

entities.name: Chalco Shanxi Alumina Refinery (Ga recovery)
entities.short: Chalco/Chinalco integrated Bayer refinery recovering Ga from liquor; Chalco is the largest single Ga producer (~160 t/yr).

entities.name: Rio Tinto Vaudreuil Alumina Refinery (Ga project)
entities.short: Canada's only alumina refinery; first primary gallium extracted with Indium Corp (2025); demo plant up to 3.5 t/yr, ~40 t/yr target.

entities.name: Alcoa Wagerup Alumina Refinery (Ga project)
entities.short: Alcoa/JAGA (Sojitz+JOGMEC) gallium recovery from Bayer liquor; FID 2026, ~100 t/yr (~10% of global demand).

entities.name: Nyrstar Clarksville Zinc Smelter
entities.short: Only US primary zinc smelter; Ga/Ge concentrate in refining-residue ponds feeds a planned recovery facility.

entities.name: Akita Zinc Iijima Refinery
entities.short: Japan's largest zinc smelter (DOWA); Ga/In/Ge report to intermediate residues → DOWA rare-metal recovery.

entities.name: Korea Zinc Onsan Smelter
entities.short: Building a gallium recovery plant (~15.5 t/yr, pilot H1 2028) recovering Ga as a zinc-processing byproduct.

entities.name: Binzhou Jiayuan Gallium Plant
entities.short: Recovers gallium from Huihong Bayer liquor; 30 t/yr Phase 1 (60 t/yr design); Zhuhai Fangyuan 24%.

entities.name: Xiaoyi Xing'an Gallium
entities.short: Shanxi gallium producer (JV incl. Nanjing Jinmei / AXT); recovers/refines Ga from local Bayer alumina operations.

entities.name: ERG Pavlodar Alumina — Gallium Recovery
entities.short: ~15 t/yr Ga from Pavlodar alumina Bayer liquor (from Q3 2026); Mitsubishi offtake. (Alumina route, not zinc — corrected.)

entities.name: Nyrstar Clarksville Ge/Ga Recovery Facility
entities.short: ~$90M plant to recover Ga (~30-40 t/yr) & Ge from zinc-refining residue ponds; Korea Zinc-acquired.

entities.name: DOWA Akita / Kosaka Rare-Metal Recovery
entities.short: Recovers gallium from Akita Zinc residues AND GaAs/semiconductor scrap; feeds DOWA's Hachioji purification.

entities.name: Indium Corporation Ga Reclaim (Rome, NY)
entities.short: DOE TRACE-Ga-funded prototype reclaiming metallic gallium from scrap; target ≥1 t/yr of 99.99% Ga.

entities.name: Zhuzhou Keneng Gallium Refinery
entities.short: High-purity (4N-6N) gallium refiner for semiconductor/display customers (plasma refining).

entities.name: DOWA Electronics Hachioji Gallium Purification
entities.short: Refines recovered gallium to 6N; the only non-Chinese commercial 6N producer; world No.1 in high-purity gallium sales.

entities.name: Vital Pure Metal Solutions (Langelsheim)
entities.short: Ex-PPM Pure Metals; integrated high-purity gallium recovery+refining, now Vital Materials.

entities.name: Vital Materials (Zhuzhou / Guangzhou)
entities.short: Top-3 global gallium producer; high-purity (up to 7N) with recycling/closed-loop recovery.
